lessons: The same session read twice is two different pages, and only the fetch time tells them apart: Apple moved 1.12pp between a pre-close build and a settled one without trading.
A name that is quiet in the corpus and violent in the tape is the case the collector exists for and handles worst: the largest move in the book's record produced zero rows.
A confirming observation can arrive and still not move the name; without a figure the page cannot tell priced-in from not-this-company's-cost.
A beta that flips sign from page to page measures the window, not the market leg; on such a name the residual is the move, and a market component of +0.03% is the window in print.
An entity match on one word is not a mention: Genting Plantations in a momentum list is not Genting Bhd.
